label: dragIsOneStep: the drag token not passed to setFill, so 120 moves are 120 undo steps
find: try target.setFill(try change(selection.fill, selection.box), in: selection.box, name: title, drag: drag)
replace: try target.setFill(try change(selection.fill, selection.box), in: selection.box, name: title, drag: nil)

label: angleNeedsLinear: the angle allowed on a radial fill
oneStepPerRun: setFill called twice per edit, so a run records two steps
aBadStopIndexFails: the stop index not checked, so a move past the end records a step
